title: ORCHID-SAGE: Systematic Assessment of Gibbs Energies
description:
ORCHID-SAGE is a standard for fully reproducible CALPHAD assessments: general and specific protocols, their schema and validator, a reproduction tool that reruns a protocol and compares the result within declared tolerances, an MCP server for agents, and the Cr–Ni assessment that accompanies the paper ORCHID-SAGE: Fully Reproducible CALPHAD Assessment from Evidence to Phase Diagram.

Code is released under the MIT licence; protocols, the schema, documentation and data under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSES.md).
notes: This work was supported by the U.S. National Science Foundation under awards OAC-2608825 (CSSI: Elements: PhaseForge) and DMR-2534344. Supplement to the paper ORCHID-SAGE: Fully Reproducible CALPHAD Assessment from Evidence to Phase Diagram (DOI pending; to be added as related identifier, relation isSupplementTo). Protocols, schema and data are CC BY 4.0.
